描述_EN: the bottle is in the form of a large horn-shaped gourd. a black ground covers the whole bottle and on each of the two sides is a vine and a butterfly. it has shoulders curving into a cylindrical neck with a very wide neck-hole and no stopper. it does not have a foot or a base and is not freestanding. it is made of porcelain, moulded in low relief and painted in enamel colours, black, green, yellow and red.
描述_ZN: 该瓶呈大角形葫芦状。 黑色的地面覆盖了整个瓶子，在两边各有一个藤蔓和一只蝴蝶。 它的肩部弯曲成一个圆柱形的颈部，有一个很宽的颈孔，没有塞子。 它没有脚或底座，不是独立的。 它是由瓷器制成的，以低浮雕的方式成型，并涂有珐琅彩，黑色、绿色、黄色和红色。
